event_summary: A dark upper head stays in contact with a smooth white rounded mass while small crumbs, white fragments, and dark specks move around the base and then become less airborne.
raw_event_description: The view begins with a close-up of a dark ridged upper component already positioned against the top of a white rounded mass on a tan surface. Brown-orange crumbly material, white bits, and dark specks are visible around the lower edge of the white mass. In the early part, many small particles are suspended or moving near the base, especially along the lower and right sides. Through the sequence, the white mass remains broad, smooth, and flattened-looking beneath the dark central protrusion, while the debris around the base shifts slightly and the amount of airborne particulate decreases. By the end, most visible particles are near the surface, with an orange-brown crumb cluster still present along the lower right edge.

reasons: The dark upper component is cropped by the top edge of the frame.
The white mass is already in contact with or directly beneath the dark central protrusion at the first visible moment.
Small debris and suspended particles are already visible around the base.
